2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1431 of 2023,
registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the IPC and Sections 4 of the D.P. Act.
3.
It is a case of matrimonial dispute.
The complainant is wife of the petitioner.
She alleges atrocities by her husband and his family members for non-fulfillment of demand of dowry and ultimately she was ousted from her matrimonial house.
4. In compliance with the order dated 07.10.2025, the maternal grandfather (Nana) of the children has handed over his Patna High Court CR.

Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances in the event of his arrest or surrender within four weeks before the learned court below, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned SDJM, Samastipur in connection with Complaint Case No. 1431 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the CrPC/482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.
7.
The maternal grandfather of the children is present in the Court.
He is directed that whenever the petitioner is willing to meet his children, the maternal grandfather is obliged to facilitate the meetings.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.30373 of 2025(6) dt.02-12-2025 8.

In case of failure to pay the above-noted amount without any reasonable cause, the learned court below shall pass an appropriate order,
including the cancellation of the petitioner's bail bond.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) Nirmal/-
